segments.text: An unmarked crossroads. No signs, no traffic lights. So the rule is: give way to the right.
But today, the one coming from the right is a giant tortoise. Top speed: one metre per minute. What do you do?
Most drivers think: it's so slow, I'll just go first.
Big mistake. The tortoise saw that. Blue light on. It's a police tortoise. And now, it's chasing you.
Slowly. Days. Months. Years. Your car rusts. A tree grows through it. Until finally, it catches you. Ticket!
Here's how you do it properly.
Stop, and give way. Rules are rules, even for tortoises.
But at this speed, you'd wait till Christmas. So grab a fishing rod, and dangle a strawberry.
Now it's a turbo tortoise. Zoom! Across in three seconds.
It gets the strawberry. You get the road. Drive on.
Next exam question: a knight on horseback, in your blind spot. Follow, so you don't miss it.
